decisions.question: Use indexed per-agent replay pages and persisted round-robin retention cursors
decisions.chosen: Use indexed per-agent replay pages and persisted round-robin retention cursors
decisions.reasoning: D1 insights show millions of retained rows read per replay and empty retention pass; row deletion limits alone do not bound database work.

decisions.question: Fence retention traversals and skip rows newer than every applicable TTL
decisions.chosen: Fence retention traversals and skip rows newer than every applicable TTL
decisions.reasoning: Bounded pages must still wrap under continuous arrivals; a shortest-policy cutoff avoids wasting cycles on millions of recent rows. Preserve the existing expiry capacity, which was sized for a 519k/day peak.

decisions.question: Require the engine release and staged D1 migration before the coordinated cloud rollout
decisions.chosen: Require the engine release and staged D1 migration before the coordinated cloud rollout
decisions.reasoning: Cloud currently pins 8.5.2; a merged coordinator PR cannot by itself deploy these new engine query plans. No production mutations or remote broker restarts authorized in this implementation.
